requirements.discovery: Our registered user/managed hook files must remain discoverable at their OS-specific paths.
requirements.registration: Owned event groups, command handlers and matchers must remain valid.
requirements.delivery: Required enforcement events must reach our hook at the expected stage.
requirements.payload: Consumed fields must retain compatible names and JSON types.
requirements.decision: The host must keep accepting and enforcing our emitted blocking response.
requirements.failure: Blocking exit codes and failure handling must not become fail-open.
requirements.execution: Ordering, synchronous execution, launchers and timeouts must preserve enforcement.
requirements.correlation: Tool identity must correlate proposal/result events and lifecycle cleanup.
